s0501.literal: The new canal at Jizhou was completed, and the Capital Transport Commission was established.
s0501.idiomatic: The new canal at Jizhou was completed, and the capital transport commission was established.

s0502.literal: On gengxu day palace guard troops returning from duty were rewarded.
s0502.idiomatic: On gengxu day palace guard troops returning from duty were rewarded.

s0503.literal: Paper money, sheep, and horses were granted to the troops under Prince of Bei'an.
s0503.idiomatic: Paper money, sheep, and horses were granted to the troops under the Prince of Bei'an.

s0504.literal: Ninth month, on renzi day, Venus transgressed the Maiden of Xuanyuan.
s0504.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renzi day, Venus transgressed the Maiden of Xuanyuan.

s0505.literal: On wuwu day Heladai and others induced submission of the Xiangshan County sea bandits You Zongzu and nine thousand five hundred ninety-two others; the sea routes were pacified.
s0505.idiomatic: On wuwu day Heladai and others induced submission of the Xiangshan County sea bandits You Zongzu and 9,592 others, and the sea routes were pacified.

s0507.literal: On renxu day Li troops were mobilized to campaign against Japan together.
s0507.idiomatic: On renxu day Li troops were mobilized for the campaign against Japan.

s0508.literal: On bingyin day the country of Gudanu, through merchants including Alawei, came to declare its wish to submit.
s0508.idiomatic: On bingyin day the country of Gudanu, through merchants including Alawei, declared its wish to submit.

s0509.literal: Champa and Jinghu branch secretariats were merged into one.
s0509.idiomatic: The Champa and Jinghu branch secretariats were merged into one.

s0510.literal: Old city's market bureaus, guild offices, and tax offices were all moved into Dadu; tax collection was reduced to one-fortieth.
s0510.idiomatic: The old city's market bureaus, guild offices, and tax offices were all moved into Dadu, and tax collection was reduced to one-fortieth.

s0511.literal: Zhu Yunlong was rewarded for grain transport merit, made chief supervisor of rank seven, and given silks.
s0511.idiomatic: Zhu Yunlong was rewarded for grain transport merit, made a rank-seven chief supervisor, and given silks.

s0512.literal: On jisi day Venus transgressed Right Law.
s0512.idiomatic: On jisi day Venus transgressed Right Law.

s0513.literal: On xinwei day, because the harvest was good, wine prohibitions in all routes were lifted.
s0513.idiomatic: On xinwei day, because the harvest was good, wine prohibitions in all routes were lifted.

s0514.literal: Bandits rose in Guangdong; ten thousand troops were dispatched to suppress them.
s0514.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Guangdong, and ten thousand troops were dispatched to suppress them.

s0515.literal: On renshen day the moon occulted Well.
s0515.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon occulted Well.

s0516.literal: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.
s0516.idiomatic: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.

s0517.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Ghost, Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi, and Venus transgressed Left Law.
s0517.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Ghost, Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi, and Venus transgressed Left Law.

s0518.literal: On wuyin day Shi Bi proposed a plan to suppress banditry: ringleaders and co-conspirators were to die, and the rest were to garrison-farm on the Huai; the Emperor approved.
s0518.idiomatic: On wuyin day Shi Bi proposed a plan to suppress banditry: ringleaders and co-conspirators were to die, and the rest were to garrison-farm on the Huai; the Emperor approved.

s0519.literal: An edict entrusted the matter to Bi; bandit followers were to farm on inner territory, and their wives and children were sent to the capital to supply the hawk offices and others.
s0519.idiomatic: An edict entrusted the matter to Bi; bandit followers were to farm on inner territory, and their wives and children were sent to the capital to supply the hawk offices and others.

s0520.literal: Tenth month of winter, on gengyin day, thirty thousand ingots of paper money were granted to newly submitted troops on the Japan campaign.
s0520.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on gengyin day, 30,000 ingots of paper money were granted to newly submitted troops on the Japan campaign.

s0521.literal: On renchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu by the Gubeikou road.
s0521.idiomatic: On renchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu by the Gubeikou road.

s0522.literal: On gisi day Wanduan pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.
s0522.idiomatic: On gisi day Wanduan pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.

s0523.literal: On jiawu day Grand Councillor Zharsan was made vice director of the Privy Council.
s0523.idiomatic: On jiawu day Grand Councillor Zharsan was made vice director of the Privy Council.

s0524.literal: An edict stated: "The Five Guard armies each year in the tenth month of winter may have five-tenths return home to prepare equipment; in the first month those on duty shall rotate and half return; by the fourth month all enter service.
s0524.idiomatic: An edict stated, "The Five Guard armies each year in the tenth month of winter may have five-tenths return home to prepare equipment; in the first month those on duty shall rotate and half return; by the fourth month all enter service.

s0525.literal: " At that time each guard proposed sending seven men first while three substituted for themselves; this was approved.
s0525.idiomatic: " At that time each guard proposed sending seven men first while three substituted for themselves; this was approved.

s0526.literal: On yiwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0526.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0527.literal: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Pleiades.
s0527.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Pleiades.

s0528.literal: On dingyou day Champa troops who had fled back were executed.
s0528.idiomatic: On dingyou day Champa troops who had fled back were executed.

s0529.literal: Mangudai requested increasing Mongol and Han troops garrisoning the frontier; this was approved.
s0529.idiomatic: Mangudai requested increasing Mongol and Han troops garrisoning the frontier; the request was approved.

s0530.literal: Huduhu was put in overall charge of Suodu's newly increased troops in the Yangzhou branch secretariat.
s0530.idiomatic: Huduhu was put in overall charge of Suodu's newly increased troops in the Yangzhou branch secretariat.

s0531.literal: On gengzi day Asudai troops were permitted to substitute service with brothers.
s0531.idiomatic: On gengzi day Asudai troops were permitted to substitute service with brothers.

s0532.literal: Jianning Route military commander Huang Hua rebelled with nearly a hundred thousand followers, styling himself the Head-Tonsure Army and falsely declaring the fifth year of Song Xiangxing; he attacked Chong'an, Pucheng, and other counties and besieged Jianning Prefecture.
s0532.idiomatic: Jianning Route military commander Huang Hua rebelled with nearly 100,000 followers, styling himself the Head-Tonsure Army and falsely declaring the fifth year of Song Xiangxing; he attacked Chong'an, Pucheng, and other counties and besieged Jianning Prefecture.

s0533.literal: An edict ordered Bolinjidai and Shi Bi and others to lead twenty-two thousand troops to suppress and pacify them.
s0533.idiomatic: An edict ordered Bolinjidai and Shi Bi and others to lead 22,000 troops to suppress and pacify them.

s0535.literal: On renyin day land and water relay stations from Dong'e to the Imperial Canal were established to facilitate transport.
s0535.idiomatic: On renyin day land and water relay stations from Dong'e to the Imperial Canal were established to facilitate transport.

s0536.literal: The Tanzhou relay station of Jizhou was moved to Luqiao town on the new canal.
s0536.idiomatic: The Tanzhou relay station of Jizhou was moved to Luqiao town on the new canal.

s0537.literal: Paper money was granted to impoverished households in Ganzhou delivering sulfur.
s0537.idiomatic: Paper money was granted to impoverished households in Ganzhou delivering sulfur.

s0538.literal: On guimao day Prince Jibitemür requested a census of civilian households on his appanage in Changde Prefecture; this was denied.
s0538.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince Jibitemür requested a census of civilian households on his appanage in Changde Prefecture; the request was denied.

s0539.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "At two places on Abaqchi's new canal there are granaries; small boats should be built to divide sea transport.
s0539.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "At two places on Abaqchi's new canal there are granaries; small boats should be built to divide sea transport.

s0541.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Yiyimisi once requested instructing all Jiangnan commanderies to recruit people to plant fields in Huainan.
s0541.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Yiyimisi once requested instructing all Jiangnan commanderies to recruit people to plant fields in Huainan.

s0542.literal: Now he goes to each commandery collecting civilian households; branch secretariat official Kuku Nitudun said this was unsuitable — they should be recruited at his seat of administration and the people must not be forced.
s0542.idiomatic: Now he goes to each commandery collecting civilian households; branch secretariat official Kuku Nitudun said this was unsuitable — they should be recruited at his seat of administration and the people must not be forced.

s0544.literal: On wushen day one thousand bolts of silk and three hundred ingots of paper money were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary among the Udege.
s0544.idiomatic: On wushen day 1,000 bolts of silk and 300 ingots of paper money were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary among the Udege.

s0545.literal: The Karakorum price-stabilization treasury was established.
s0545.idiomatic: The Karakorum price-stabilization treasury was established.

s0546.literal: Officials were dispatched to investigate fraud in Yidu's gold panning.
s0546.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to investigate fraud in Yidu's gold panning.

s0547.literal: The Zhongxing revenue superintendentate and Beijing salt-and-iron revenue superintendentate were abolished.
s0547.idiomatic: The Zhongxing revenue superintendentate and Beijing salt-and-iron revenue superintendentate were abolished.

s0548.literal: On jiyou day hostages' troops in Hexi of age and adult enough were enrolled as soldiers.
s0548.idiomatic: On jiyou day hostages' troops in Hexi of age and adult enough were enrolled as soldiers.

s0549.literal: On gengxu day two additional vice commissioners were added to each route's prosecuting and surveillance commission.
s0549.idiomatic: On gengxu day two additional vice commissioners were added to each route's prosecuting and surveillance commission.

s0550.literal: Eleventh month, on renzi day, Dabuhua, Toghan, and others were rewarded for battle merit with silver and silks.
s0550.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renzi day, Dabuhua, Toghan, and others were rewarded for battle merit with silver and silks.

s0551.literal: On guichou day commander Chen Yi volunteered thirty sea ships for the campaign; an edict made Yi a wanhu and granted him a tiger tally.
s0551.idiomatic: On guichou day commander Chen Yi volunteered thirty sea ships for the campaign; an edict made Yi a wanhu and granted him a tiger tally.

s0552.literal: Yi was originally named Wuhu, rose from sea banditry, and after submission his elder brother became pacification commissioner while Yi became commander.
s0552.idiomatic: Yi was originally named Wuhu, rose from sea banditry, and after submission his elder brother became pacification commissioner while Yi became commander.

s0553.literal: An order directed that all bandits must be tried by civilian officials and private settlements were forbidden.
s0553.idiomatic: An order directed that all bandits must be tried by civilian officials and private settlements were forbidden.

s0554.literal: On dingsi day all provinces were ordered to print the Granting the Seasons Calendar.
s0554.idiomatic: On dingsi day all provinces were ordered to print the Granting the Seasons Calendar.

s0555.literal: Prince Jibitemür requested setting up revenue officials himself in twenty-four cities on his appanage; this was denied.
s0555.idiomatic: Prince Jibitemür requested setting up revenue officials himself in twenty-four cities on his appanage; the request was denied.

s0556.literal: He also requested establishing monopoly tax offices whose chiefs would be appointed by the metropolitan secretariat and whose subordinates would be assigned by the princely house; this was approved.
s0556.idiomatic: He also requested establishing monopoly tax offices whose chiefs would be appointed by the metropolitan secretariat and whose subordinates would be assigned by the princely house; the request was approved.

s0557.literal: An edict stated: "Land in Dadu shall all pay tax;
s0557.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Land in Dadu shall all pay tax;

s0558.literal: newly surveyed land in Ganzhou shall pay three sheng rent per mu.
s0558.idiomatic: newly surveyed land in Ganzhou shall pay three sheng rent per mu.

s0559.literal: " On jiwei day Minister of Personnel Liu Haoli presented customary matters of the Kirghiz.
s0559.idiomatic: " On jiwei day Minister of Personnel Liu Haoli presented customary matters of the Kirghiz.

s0560.literal: On renxu day the Nanjing pacification commission was re-established.
s0560.idiomatic: On renxu day the Nanjing pacification commission was re-established.

s0561.literal: On yichou day the Kaicheng Route garrison-farming command was abolished and merged into Kaicheng Route under the Jingzhao pacification commission.
s0561.idiomatic: On yichou day the Kaicheng Route garrison-farming command was abolished and merged into Kaicheng Route under the Jingzhao pacification commission.

s0562.literal: On wuchen day the Directorate of Agriculture was established to manage official fields, lodges, and people.
s0562.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Directorate of Agriculture was established to manage official fields, lodges, and people.

s0563.literal: Sheep and horses were granted to Saga'er, Ulug, and others under the princes to relieve their want.
s0563.idiomatic: Sheep and horses were granted to Saga'er, Ulug, and others under the princes to relieve their want.

s0564.literal: Han were employed alongside others in Hexi government offices.
s0564.idiomatic: Han were employed alongside others in Hexi government offices.

s0565.literal: Gansu Shazhou civilian households were moved back to restore their occupations.
s0565.idiomatic: Gansu Shazhou civilian households were moved back to restore their occupations.

s0566.literal: Gate wardens were established at Dadu's city gates.
s0566.idiomatic: Gate wardens were established at Dadu's city gates.

s0567.literal: On dingchou day Yunnan revenue officials were forbidden to collect surplus cash beyond the fixed quota.
s0567.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yunnan revenue officials were forbidden to collect surplus cash beyond the fixed quota.

s0568.literal: On wuyin day powerful persons in Yunnan were forbidden to extract excessive debt interest; enslaving persons by seizure and tattooing their faces were also banned.
s0568.idiomatic: On wuyin day powerful persons in Yunnan were forbidden to extract excessive debt interest; enslaving persons by seizure and tattooing their faces were also banned.

s0570.literal: On jimao day, at the request of princes Tubai and Monggol Dai and others, Yetügu and others were rewarded with silver and paper money to honor battle merit.
s0570.idiomatic: On jimao day, at the request of princes Tubai and Monggol Dai and others, Yetügu and others were rewarded with silver and paper money to honor battle merit.

s0571.literal: One thousand ingots of paper money were granted to the crown prince.
s0571.idiomatic: One thousand ingots of paper money were granted to the crown prince.

s0572.literal: Fined paper money from the Censorate was granted to qielian retainers.
s0572.idiomatic: Fined paper money from the Censorate was granted to qielian retainers.

s0573.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, clothing was granted to Prince Qundu Temür, and silver, paper money, and silks to Hudur's command.
s0573.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, clothing was granted to Prince Qundu Temür, and silver, paper money, and silks to Hudur's command.

s0574.literal: On jiashen day seven thousand sets of clothing and silks and two thousand horses were granted to Besudai's command.
s0574.idiomatic: On jiashen day 7,000 sets of clothing and silks and 2,000 horses were granted to Besudai's command.

s0575.literal: Xifan army officers including Ainabasi were rewarded for battle merit.
s0575.idiomatic: Xifan army officers including Ainabasi were rewarded for battle merit.

s0576.literal: On xinmao day six thousand troops under Chahu were prepared for the Japan campaign.
s0576.idiomatic: On xinmao day 6,000 troops under Chahu were prepared for the Japan campaign.

s0577.literal: On renchen day cattle prices were granted to Prince Ajiji.
s0577.idiomatic: On renchen day cattle prices were granted to Prince Ajiji.

s0578.literal: Because Central Secretariat deliberator Undeken Tuluhua was honest though poor and did not flatter the powerful, one hundred ingots were granted.
s0578.idiomatic: Because Central Secretariat deliberator Undeken Tuluhua was honest though poor and did not flatter the powerful, he received one hundred ingots.

s0579.literal: The prohibition on Jurchen mining and exporting gold and silver was lifted.
s0579.idiomatic: The prohibition on Jurchen mining and exporting gold and silver was lifted.

s0580.literal: On jiawu day forty thousand ingots were granted for government grain purchases at Shangdu.
s0580.idiomatic: On jiawu day 40,000 ingots were granted for government grain purchases at Shangdu.

s0581.literal: Impoverished gate guards each received twenty ingots.
s0581.idiomatic: Impoverished gate guards each received twenty ingots.

s0582.literal: On xinchou day silver was granted to Prince Xiliemen and others.
s0582.idiomatic: On xinchou day silver was granted to Prince Xiliemen and others.

s0583.literal: Sea-route grain transport pacification commissioner Zhu Qing was made a mid-level wanhu and granted a tiger tally;
s0583.idiomatic: Sea-route grain transport pacification commissioner Zhu Qing was made a mid-level wanhu and granted a tiger tally;

s0584.literal: Zhang Xuan's son Wenhu was made a qianhu and granted a gold tally.
s0584.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan's son Wenhu was made a qianhu and granted a gold tally.

s0585.literal: Newly submitted officials were transferred to serve in inner commanderies.
s0585.idiomatic: Newly submitted officials were transferred to serve in inner commanderies.

s0586.literal: Li Prefecture was returned to subordination under Zhending Route.
s0586.idiomatic: Li Prefecture was returned to subordination under Zhending Route.

s0587.literal: On guimao day grain was distributed to relieve forty-nine Udege relay stations.
s0587.idiomatic: On guimao day grain was distributed to relieve forty-nine Udege relay stations.

s0588.literal: On jiachen day the moon occulted Mars.
s0588.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon occulted Mars.

s0589.literal: On bingwu day Yunnan's gold-foil manufacture-and-sale planning office was abolished.
s0589.idiomatic: On bingwu day Yunnan's gold-foil manufacture-and-sale planning office was abolished.

s0590.literal: Yunnan's grand marshal's headquarters was abolished and officials were re-established.
s0590.idiomatic: Yunnan's grand marshal's headquarters was abolished and officials were re-established.

s0591.literal: Regulations for hostages were fixed: children of high officials were to be sent to the capital.
s0591.idiomatic: Regulations for hostages were fixed: children of high officials were to be sent to the capital.

s0592.literal: On wushen day the youth Tong raised troops in rebellion in Shizhou, Yunnan; associate administrator Aqa Bashi was ordered to lead troops, and together with Luolosi Tuo'ershihe to suppress them; ten thousand bolts were granted to relieve one thousand famine-stricken Jurchen households.
s0592.idiomatic: On wushen day the youth Tong raised troops in rebellion in Shizhou, Yunnan; associate administrator Aqa Bashi was ordered to lead troops, and together with Luolosi Tuo'ershihe to suppress them; 10,000 bolts were granted to relieve 1,000 famine-stricken Jurchen households.

s0593.literal: That year two hundred seventy-eight persons were sentenced to death.
s0593.idiomatic: That year 278 persons were sentenced to death.
